summary: AIAI Holdings filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026, disclosing a Common Stock Purchase Agreement and Registration Rights Agreement with B. Riley Principal Capital II, LLC allowing the company to sell up to $200,000,000 of newly issued Class A common stock at its sole discretion over 36 months from a Commencement Date. Sales occur via Market Open Purchases subject to a $1.00 threshold price and a resale registration statement. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The equity line provides flexible, dilutive capital with resale overhang; watch share issuance pace, registration effectiveness and pricing terms due to limited disclosure.
